(1) Write a seeded offender into each declared root, run it, remove it in a finally, and it must fire; this catches a dropped extends, emptied jsPlugins, a widened ignorePatterns or .oxlintignore. runLint is injected: default spawns oxlint with the consumer config (v3-sk-4 passes the CLI runner later). (2) extends names the generated preset. (3) no managed id in rules or overrides[*].rules, and no source file under a declared root where findBlanketDisables (packages/basalt-ui/src/lint/blanket-disable.ts, shipped by issue 1009) reports a file-level disable that hides waiver-needs-reason itself: the host drops that finding before the rule reports it, so only a comment scan sees it; the check names each file and line. (4) installed oxlint equals the preset pin. (5) .basalt/budget.json ejects and waivers do not exceed git show <default-remote-branch>:.basalt/budget.json; no base ref returns skipped, never passed. A required check that cannot run is reported skipped (it fails in doctor). Rule: none. Skill snippet: none. Test: weakened.test.ts over the fixture configs.
